notes: 11 of 14 searches used. Unidentified NHS trust leaflet claims (cold vs flu comparison, 2-7 day recovery, antivirals for healthy adults) removed or replaced by CDC/NHS England/NHS Borders text. Death as complication, 'main recommended protection', vaccine updated yearly, devolved-nations sentence, CDC 'one day before symptoms' removed as not retrieved. Several summaries blend pages, so attribution of NHS England items (symptoms list, 999 and urgent lists, aspirin, antibiotics, 'first five days') rests on search summaries of nhs.uk/conditions/flu rather than quoted page text. 'Symptoms very quickly' comes from an NHS ICB summary. NHS Borders leaflet is dated 2014. NICE CKS not retrieved. Sentences re-used in rebuilt sections (e.g. NHS symptom list in FAQ 1) are claims already counted. References changed to pages the searches returned; CDC spread and testing pages dropped.
